purpose: Teach: マヤ/デビッド/アンドリュー/トマス/ザック/ゲール/キティ/マンセー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、メキシコのマヤ文明のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi told me her customer was talking about Mayan civilization in Mexico.
lines.style: Warm, observant recall. Soft opening. Voice settles into a gentle cataloging tone—she's holding these details like they matter. Unhurried pacing. Slight smile underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国のデビッド・ボウイの曲を愛されてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi mentioned her customer loves David Bowie's music.
lines.style: Continuing the same gentle inventory. No change in warmth. Voice stays low and intimate—Aoi's noticing these small loves about people. Steady, even pace. A kind of tenderness in the listing itself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、英国のアンドリュー王子のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi said her customer was sharing stories about Prince Andrew.
lines.style: Same anchored warmth. The cadence remains unhurried, accepting. No judgment in the selection—just another detail she's collected about someone. Slightly trailing voice at the end, as if more could follow.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、機関車トーマスのキャラ、つまりトマスがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi told me her customer loves Thomas the Tank Engine.
lines.style: Still that same warm, observant listing. A touch more lightness now—there's something endearing about this detail. Voice brightens fractionally but stays grounded. No performance, just noticing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様のお名前がザックくんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi mentioned her customer's child is named Zack.
lines.style: The warmth deepens slightly—this is a child now, another person to hold in the inventory. Voice stays low and sure. Pacing remains steady, almost meditative. Care without sentiment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国ゲール語、つまりゲールの言語学を学ばれてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi said her customer is studying Gaelic language and linguistics.
lines.style: Back to the steady warmth. Intelligence in this detail—Aoi notices intellectual curiosity too. Voice stays level and genuine. No rush. The factual delivery makes it more touching, not less.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、サンリオのハローキティがお好みだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi told me her customer loves Hello Kitty from Sanrio.
lines.style: Same grounded warmth. The catalog continues, unrushed. Voice carries subtle affection—these preferences are innocent, genuine. Steady pacing. A faint smile in the delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、韓国旅行で「マンセー!」って大声で叫んだお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi was sharing how her customer shouted 'Manse!' loudly during a trip to Korea.
lines.style: A gentle shift now—there's a touch more light in this memory, almost like Aoi is remembering the joy of it. Voice stays warm but gains a small spark of delight. Slightly brighter pace on the recalled moment. Knowing smile underneath.
